The event consumed by

when a
Modelled Process
terminates without justified reason, for ex-
ample:
•
termination without prior request where
termination-
Behavior

nating

Please note that every
Unexpected Self-termination
is
also an
Unexpected Termination
, so requirements for the
later apply here as well.
